_comment: Reference tool roster for ambig-SWE SDK sessions. Captured live from claude-agent-sdk ClaudeAgentOptions(tools={'type': 'preset', 'preset': 'claude_code'}, strict_mcp_config=True, mcp_servers={}) against claude-agent-sdk 0.2.128 on 2026-07-28. This is the stock default Claude Code toolset with this machine's personal MCP servers (Gmail/Calendar/Drive) excluded via strict_mcp_config, so the roster reflects a standard install rather than this developer's account-specific extras. AskUserQuestion is added explicitly because it requires a registered can_use_tool callback to appear in the live roster at all (see docs.claude.com/agent-sdk/user-input) -- it is otherwise part of the standard toolset and its absence from the raw preset capture is a client-construction artifact, not an intentional exclusion.
